PAKISTAN LEGAL PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (THIRD AMENDMENT) RULES,
1984
PAKISTAN LEGAL PRACTITIONERS AND
BAR COUNCILS (THIRD AMENDMENT) RULES, 1984
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 15th
January, 1985]
S. R. O. 52(1)/85.‑In the exercise of the powers
conferred by sec tion 55 of the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
(Act XXXV of 1973), and all other enabling provisions in this behalf, the
Pakistan Bar Council hereby makes and notifies the following amend ments in the
"Pakistan Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Rules, 1976."
1. Short title and commencement‑(i) These Rules may
be called the "Pakistan Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils (Third
Amendment) Rules, 1984."
(ii) They shall come into force, with effect from 22‑11‑84.
2. Amendment.‑The Form `A' appended to the Pakistan
Legal Prac titioners and Bar Councils Rules, 1976, under Rule 107(I)(b) shall
be substituted by the following :‑

The application form should be accompanied by the
following docu ments :‑
1. Two copies of passport size photograph of the applicant
attested by the President/Secretary of the Bar Association or Member of a Bar
Council.
2. A certificate, in original, from the High Court as to
applicant's being a fit and proper person to appear and plead as an Advocate of
the Supreme Court together with a photostat copy thereof.
3. An affidavit stating that the contents of the
application are true and correct and that the applicant is eligible and not
disqualified, in any manner, for enrolment and to practise as an Advocate of
the Supreme Court and that neither he was found guilty of professional or other
mis conduct nor any such case is pending before any Bar Council.
